text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Another summer camp has come to an
end. I join Symboli Rudolf in seeing the
rest of the students
off safely before
getting on the last bus.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if the rest of the students
improved as
much as they hoped.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Did they meet the targets they had set
for
themselves? Do they feel they've had
a
productive summer?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I've left them much more to their own
devices this year. I know they've been
working hard—I've seen
it—but still, I
worry.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Mhm... I think so too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
There's that controlling streak of yours
again.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Haha. I'm well aware of it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Forget about them. Have you been
working hard?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: But of course. Isn't that right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I meant to ask. Are you finished
making the
final checks?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Of course. Air Groove should be along
soon too.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Excellent. Then we can be off as soon as
she
arrives.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Heh...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: What are you smiling about?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Oh, nothing.
I just realized that it will be
you, me,
my trainer and Air Groove
boarding the last bus.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Quite the gathering, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I've caused you all no end of trouble
over the
years. And what's more—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Save it for when the Empress gets back.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
She handles sappy talk better than I do.
You
know I hate that stuff.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And yet you still listen. You truly are
kind at
heart.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: What?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I said what I said. You're a kind person.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Whaddaya think you're—tch, forget it.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'm back, President. I'm sorry I kept you
wai—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Um, what is Brian doing? Isn't it a little
hot to be
wrapped up in a blanket?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Haha. I wonder.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'll say this: between you three and the
other student council members, I
couldn't have been
blessed with better
friends.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The bus sets off, bearing us gently back
to the
academy...
